criteria.requirement: Add registered segmented-list RST directive with required pipe-CSV columns option, optional inline-formatted title, class/name and pipe-CSV content rows. Parse through real Directive/state.inline_text into table/tgroup/colspec/thead/tbody/row/entry nodes and actual HTML writer output. Preserve quoted pipes, empty cells, Unicode/inline markup and ordinary non-directive colon paragraphs. Reject absent/empty headings, malformed CSV or inconsistent row widths with real directive diagnostics and no half table. Do not implement as raw HTML/text substitution or change existing table/list-table syntax.
